name: PokéAPI
description: Everything about Pokémon: species, types, abilities, moves and more. The responses are big and deeply nested, which makes them great for exploring with the JSON tree.

requests.name: Get a Pokémon
requests.description: Returns one Pokémon by name or number. Try replacing pikachu with bulbasaur or 25.

requests.name: List Pokémon
requests.description: Returns names and links, a page at a time. Use "next" in the response to get the following page.

requests.name: Species details
requests.description: Flavour text, evolution chain link, habitat and other species details.

requests.name: Get a type
requests.description: What a type is strong and weak against, and which Pokémon have it.

requests.name: Get an ability
requests.description: What an ability does, and which Pokémon can have it.
